conceptNote: 赤い全画面の中に白いチャットを収め、再生と会話を強いコントラストでひと目に伝える。
prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: refined Chrome Web Store promotional discovery tile. One original image, landscape 11:7 target 1760 x 1120, not panorama. ABSOLUTELY NO WORDS, NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO NUMBERS, NO PSEUDO-LETTERS. Explain fullscreen video with live chat overlay by geometry alone. Sophisticated contemporary flat graphic, vivid warm red #ef3e36 field, warm white #fff7ef lines and surfaces, dark burgundy small details. One large widescreen video rectangle outlined in warm white, 82% canvas width, 68% canvas height, centered. FOUR slightly expanded white fullscreen L-shaped corner brackets at OUTERMOST corners around the ENTIRE video and chat: far right brackets beyond chat, not at seam. A white play triangle at 35% of video width, large and calm. A white live chat panel floats INSIDE video at lower-right, about 28% video width and 62% video height, clearly inset from right and bottom video edges. Four comfortably spaced message rows made ONLY of small burgundy/red avatar circles and short simple horizontal geometric strokes, blank input pill and small red send triangle at bottom. Give the whole chat panel one VERY restrained tiny speech-bubble tail at its lower left, to hint conversation, but it must remain an actual rectangular panel with rows, not an empty generic speech icon. Fullscreen rectangle continues behind it, entire video surface same red. Strong visual hierarchy, beautiful margins, crisp slightly rounded edges, controlled line weight, strong clarity at 440 x 280. No extra decorative objects, no scenery, no people, no sun or mountains, no physical monitor, no browser chrome, no 3D, no gradients, no shadows, no glossy AI effect, no logo, no watermark.
